candidate_space: page 0..=4 x offset 0x00..=0xFF x bit 0..=7 (10240 candidates)
settings_held_fixed: the zero-if-open baseline (baseline_definition); streams judged against 2400000 Hz; window 100 ms; 4 x 16384 byte transfers queued; the source unkeyed during the scan
procedure: read byte; write it with the bit flipped; measure 100 ms (bytes already queued before the window counted as stale); restore; verify the restore by read-back; chip answering; the baseline's settings re-read (baseline_definition), reapplied if disturbed, power cycle and the baseline from scratch if they do not hold or the chip is gone

tone_plan.why: in zero-IF the DDC sits at 0 Hz (pset_iffreq = 0) while the tuner delivers RF 300 MHz at its 4.57 MHz IF: the tone is stepped across RF = LO - 4.57 MHz + {0, +-0.2, +-0.5, +-1.0} MHz and RF = LO itself, and ANY spectral line that moves with it is looked for (tone_lines), not one expected bin

items: a power cycle, then in order (ZERO_OPEN_ITEMS), every demodulator write a read-modify-write read back, every USB/system write read back:
DemodCtl: DEMOD_CTL |= PLL|ADC_I|ADC_Q|reset-release (Table 15) — the zero-IF baseline's item
TunerPower: GPIO3 GPD[3] = 0, GPOE[3] = 1, GPO[3] = 0, then 50 ms (Tables 16-19, p. 29) — as low-if (the zero-IF baseline's item without the 50 ms)
IicRepeat: page 1 0x01[3] = 1 (Table 3; the tuner path, findings 2) — as low-if
AdEn: page 0 0x08[7:6] = 11, AD_EN_reg = AD_EN_reg1 = 1 (Table 4, zero-IF input 9.1) — the zero-IF baseline's item
EnBbin: page 1 0xB1[0] = 1 en_bbin (Table 4, zero-IF input 9.1; 9.2: DC cancellation and IQ compensation default on with it) — the zero-IF baseline's item
IfFreqZero: pset_iffreq = 0 over page 1 0x19-0x1B (Table 6, 9.3 zero-IF example) — the zero-IF baseline's item
AgcLoops: page 1 0x04[7:5] = 110, en_if_agc = en_rf_agc = 1, aagc_hold = 0 (Table 2) — as low-if
AgcPolarity: page 0 0x0E[1:0] = 00 (Table 2; findings 4b: polarity 0 closes the IF loop through VAGC) — as low-if
Rsamp: rsamp_ratio = floor(28.8e6 / rate * 2^22) over page 1 0x9F-0xA2 [27:2] (9.4 formula, Table 7); 0x3000000 at 2.4 Msps

TunerImage: tuner::image in the vagc configuration, CLK_OUT_ENB = 0 (findings 4a), PLL for LO = 300 MHz + 4.57 MHz = 304.57 MHz (high side), SEL_DIV 010 /8, REF_DIV2 1: Nint 84, SDM 39504 (findings 4c, 4e); R5-R15 checked by the read-back; R2 VCO_INDICATOR checked in 70..=127 after 10 ms — exactly low-if's item. The tuner itself stays a low-IF part: its output is RF 300 MHz at IF 4.57 MHz ([R820T] Table 4-1), so with pset_iffreq = 0 a tone lands 4.57 MHz off the DDC's centre (or wherever the resampler folds it); the tone test steps it across offsets for that reason
EpaMaxPkt, EpaCfg, EpaFifoReset, Dma: the bulk endpoint as the zero-IF baseline sets it (Tables 30-33)

OpenPath (last): page 0 0x07 |= 0x80 (0x3C -> 0xBC), read back. data/step3-confirm-lowif-p0-07-bc.json: with the tuner programmed this bit makes the bulk endpoint deliver at the bus's full rate the FIFO memory's 3,760 bytes round and round; needs DemodCtl, IicRepeat, TunerImage

NOT written, with the reason: Spec_inv / En_aci page 1 0x15 (the zero-IF baseline does not write them; their power-on values stand and are read into the setup record); the Table 5 DC/IQ enables (on by default with en_bbin, 9.2); opt_adc_iq page 0 0x06[5:4] (no reason to swap); the tuner's own IF stays 4.57 MHz (it is a low-IF part)

tone_lines.method: per tone state: 10 log10(P_state[k] / P_off[k]) per bin, P = the averaged Hann spectrum (FFT 4096, up to 64 segments) of the state's first 524288 bytes, read as complex I/Q (even/odd bytes) and as real; the top 3 bins by rise; null = the last off state against the first; a line carries the tone when its rise exceeds the null's maximum by 6 dB, and moves with the tone when its bin differs between tone frequencies

positive_control.purpose: the low-if baseline is the state in which step 4 measured the tone: if_agc_val (MSB-first, findings 4b, about -207 counts/dB, 8191 = no signal) must fall with the tone on

source.levels: relative only: txvga nominally 1 dB per step, backoff exact digital scaling (DAC-quantised below about -40 dB); the tone sits at the offset above the source's LO, whose leakage is that far below the tone

hypothesis: 2026-10-09: every zero-IF scan so far (findings step 3) ran with en_bbin = 1 but WITHOUT the tuner configured and WITHOUT the output path open; the 45 MB/s FIFO replay (page 0 0x07 bit 7) only appears with the tuner image written and the I2C repeater open (step 3 low-if-open minimisation: DemodCtl, IicRepeat, TunerImage). The combination zero-IF baseband input (documented 9.1: AD_EN_reg = AD_EN_reg1 = 1, en_bbin = 1; 9.3 pset_iffreq = 0) + tuner configured and tuned + output path held open has never been scanned. A single control may route the baseband into the FIFO in that state: that would change the CONTENT (the 3,760-byte replay period would break) or bring the rate toward 2 x 2.4 MB/s
detector: c = [bytes/s, period score (fraction of i with data[i] == data[i+3760] over the window; null under 15040 bytes), byte-histogram entropy (bits), mean I, mean Q (unsigned), var I, var Q (unsigned), mean I, mean Q (two's complement), var I, var Q (two's complement)], I = even bytes, Q = odd bytes

detector_thresholds.rules: interesting = period score < period_min (the solo minimum - 0.01) with at least 15040 bytes in the window, OR bytes/s in [stream_lo, stream_hi] = [0.5, 2] x 2 x rate (toward 2 x sample rate); logged as 'rate changed' outside [rate_lo, rate_hi] (the solo range -/+ 20%), 'signature changed' with the entropy outside [entropy_lo, entropy_hi] (the solo range -/+ 0.05 bits)

scan_tone.why: data/step8-fifo-watch.json and data/step8-fifo-watch-lowif-open.json: in the held-open states the only new bytes that ever enter the FIFO memory are 4 bytes at one fixed position of each 188-byte block, rewritten in bursts ~2.5-3 s apart, and only while the tone is on (0 changed windows in 3 of 4 tone-off states each; the 4th is the window right after unkeying). A bit that changed what this signal-driven writer writes (whole blocks, every period) shows only with a signal present, so the scan keeps the tone keyed at the positive control's RF; its thresholds come from the tone-on solo windows (the transmitter shares the host's USB: ~37 MB/s)
scan_tone.when: keyed after the header and before the first candidate of every chunk (a scan_tone line), unkeyed before a confirmation and at the chunk's end

settings_held_fixed: the zero-if-open baseline (baseline_definition); streams judged against 2400000 Hz; window 100 ms; 4 x 16384 byte transfers queued; the source KEYED during the scan (scan_tone)
on_interesting: the line is written, the chunk ends, and confirm-write runs on the candidate's value from this baseline (rate tracking at the baseline's confirm rates — 2.4/1.2/2.048 Msps for low-if-open; for dab-open the DAB example 8.192 Msps and its ratio x2 / x1/2, 4.096 / 16.384 Msps — tone off and at two offsets from the DDC's centre RF with --source-cmd, I/Q statistics and spectrum, minimisation); a 'confirmation' line names its record

rule: a window flagged by rate alone (period intact) is measured once more, 100 ms, the flip still in place; the candidate is interesting only if the second window is flagged too. A period break is interesting at once. Both windows are on the line (c, recheck, recheck_flags, recheck_cleared)
why: with dab-open's rate targets the band around 4 x 8.192 MB/s reaches 39.3 MB/s, and a single slow window of the unchanged replay (held rate 44.4-44.6 MB/s) can fall in it: p0 0x25 b4 read 36.6 MB/s in its window and 45.0 MB/s at every rate in its confirmation (data/step3-confirm-dabopen-p0-25-10.json). Candidates before this line were judged on one window, each flagged one confirmed
